reviews.text: I have been taking my dogs for over 10 years here. They are awsome and the price is very fair. If you're looking for a place that your pets will be treated with love and care, and also not break the bank. Take them here.
The best! We've been patients for over 8 yrs, thankful to have this team in town.

These ladies that work here are very professional and knowledgeable. They helped my dog Chucky in his drastic time of need. Very reasonably priced I thought I was going to pay way more than I did. Five stars I do recommend taking your animal here.
Good place for pets ,excellent veterinary doctors ,veterinarian technicians, and staff,full of great care and love.❤️🐶🐱 …
First-class service, excellent team

Dr. Machado and his team are exceptional. The clinic is incredibly accessible, their pricing is always fair and reasonable, and everyone is genuinely kind and considerate.
My mom first recommended this practice after bringing in her three sick kittens. She was impressed not only by how affordable and accessible their care was, but also by Dr. Machado's compassionate, humane approach to treating both the animals and their owners. After my own experience, I can absolutely see why she recommended them. Thank you for caring for my Gussy💗
Always great,very professional

Amazing Clinic! Absolutely love Dr. Machado! He saved my Mini Pinschers life after other vets told me she wouldn’t make it after randomly becoming diabetic after she turned one. Got her spayed a few weeks ago and they’ve been beyond attentive and patient throughout the whole process with all of our questions. We moved to Port Saint Lucie and still travel 2 hours to their clinic. They are the only ones we trust. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
First visit after being with another vet for 25+ years. I felt comfortable with the staff. I saw staff cleaning seating and animal areas, impressive.

I took my 10-week-old kitten, Nala, to this hospital on Saturday, June 20, 2026. She was diagnosed with mange and prescribed 1.50 mL of Ivermectin. The hospital administered the first oral dose that day and instructed us to continue giving the medication every 24 hours for 14 days.
On Sunday, June 21, 2026, at approximately 1:00 p.m., my husband administered the second dose as directed. By 8:00 p.m. that evening, Nala was barely able to walk. The following morning, Monday, June 22, she was unable to eat, could not walk, and appeared extremely weak and lethargic.
Concerned about her condition, we immediately took her back to the hospital. We were advised to leave her overnight so that she could receive IV fluids and supportive care. On Tuesday, June 23, when my husband went to check on her, we were informed that Nala had passed away.
I believe this situation warrants further review. Nala's condition deteriorated rapidly after receiving the prescribed medication, and I am deeply concerned about whether the dosage was appropriate for a 10-week-old kitten. After researching online reviews, I found another account from a pet owner who reported a similar experience.
My purpose in sharing this is not only to seek accountability, but also to help prevent another pet owner from experiencing a similar loss.

Aussie is NOT what it used to be.
I wouldn’t recommend. They killed my cat and wonder often how Dr Machado sleeps at night being such a-

The staff working on my cat should feel ASHAMED of themselves. I come in for services to help my beloved cat. She is not “a thing” or a “he”. She is a SHE and she’s a beautiful girl who doesn’t deserve medical neglect, an unsanitary office, and to be BURNED by her flea medication. The staff was unempathetic and unhelpful with her bleeding mysteriously lumps that appeared after taking anti-biotics. Dr.Machado kept saying “I’m confused” everytime I’d bring up a point or concern..
he just  gave her shots to relieve her symptoms and I’m still unsure what skin reaction she has  :(

I wake up from my sleep sometimes saying “don’t take that shot!” because the antibiotics Aussie was giving her was like pouring gasoline on a fire… why couldn’t yall take 5 minutes to see what was really wrong because other vets said the “mysterious” lumps Machado was “so confused” by we’re here swollen lymph nodes!!! She needed surgery and she’d be alive. Yall just pumped medicine in her and gave PAIN.

I wish I took her somewhere else 😭😭😭😭

how could you Dr Machado?? HOW COULD YOU DO THAT TO HER??????????
She was soooooo sweet & kind &  rare!!!

If you could do that to her I have zero doubts you do this to other cats smh

Dr. Prince and her entire team were truly amazing during one of the hardest times of my life. Although my sweet Benito ultimately passed away, I will always be grateful for the compassion, kindness, and care they showed him and my family throughout the process.

Dr. Prince treated Benito with so much love and dignity, and she took the time to answer my questions and help me understand everything that was happening. Her team was equally wonderful, supportive, patient, and genuinely caring every step of the way.

Losing a pet is heartbreaking, but knowing Benito was surrounded by people who cared so deeply brought me comfort. Thank you, Dr. Prince and the entire staff, for helping us through such a difficult time and for treating Benito as if he were your own. We will never forget your kindness.
Excellent as always! They treated my cat like a princess. Qualified professionals and reasonable prices.
Fantastic location, fantastic people, fantastic service.
We love doctor Machado snd his kind staff.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for years. The staff has always been extremely kind to her and always helpful. Dr. Prince is amazing. She cares, she’s attentive, and treats my dog with so much love. I’ve seen her this way with all fur babies. She’s by far the best. 10/10 recommend!
Peter and Jose are amazing! They’re cat whisperer’s for sure. They always take such good care of my boy!
“The service is exceptional. The doctors are very professional and dedicated—you can tell they truly love their profession. The place is beautiful and spotless. The entire staff is first-class.” ⭐
Dr.Machado is very knowledgeable and caring, his prices are affordable . I love this clinic, the staff are genuinely amazing. I highly recommend this clinic.

I went with my son for my dogs rabbies vaccine and check up. I was a walk in (befor 10am)and was out in about an hour or so. The front desk, techs and veterinarian were professional and clear with everthing being done. Nothing was pushed on me and they gave me options for test and procedurs.

I am beyond grateful for the love and attention that Dr. Prince gave to my dog. Thank you so much! The staff is very attentive and helpful when I wasn't sure what to do. They really do perform miracles.
Amazing place, Dr. Prince and Dr. Machado saved my puppy and have been great through the whole process. The prices are very reasonable and everyone is very nice
This is my first time going to this vet. I loved the staffing and attention. The vet was very kind to me and my dog. I'll definitely recommend it.

Dr. Machado is exceptional. He and his staff have always been straightforward and reasonable with the care of my two dogs and I can't recommend them enough. Prices are reasonable and the care is outstanding. From routine care to surgical interventions, I have never had a better experience when it comes to veterinarian care.

I have literally been to every Vet in Cutler Bay.   Dr. Prince took the time to listen even though the office was busy.   She was knowledgeable and compassionate.  I have finally found the right person to care for my fur babies.  💜 …

they check him
they found that it was a vertebrae injury and refer me to a neurologist.
Excellent customer service, and I wasn’t charge a Penny.
Very trustworthy God bless this Dr

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Aussie Animal Clinic! From the moment I walked through the door, the staff treated my pet with genuine care, patience, and compassion. Every team member is warm, professional, and truly committed to making both pets and owners feel comfortable and supported.

The veterinarians take their time to explain everything clearly, never rushing, and you can tell they truly love what they do. They handled my pet with such gentleness and confidence that it immediately put me at ease. The clinic is clean, organized, and runs incredibly efficiently.

What I appreciate most is that they go above and beyond. Whether it’s a follow-up call, helpful advice, or simply the way they speak to your pet, they make you feel like you’re in the best possible hands.

If you’re looking for a clinic that treats your furry family member like their own, Aussie Animal Clinic is the place to go. Highly recommend!
Great staff, great experience!

Was a great place years ago, unfortunately super rundown, nelson is extremely rude and the place is EXTREMELY DIRTY. I now drive all the way to west palm to take my dog to his vet. Please don't think the other peoples bad reviews are exaggerated, the unsanitary conditions and practices in the surgical area are insane. No gloves, no cleaning of tools etc.

From the time you get greeted on the phone by Nelson to make the appointment and Dr. Machado‘s professional care towards our dogs will not be found anywhere else! He has been taking care of four of our dogs (1 Yorky, 1 Maltese and 2 Cottons) over at least 20 years with tender loving care.

I took my cat Franki to the clinic on Friday the 26th for x-rays because he had been attacked by a dog, and I wanted to know if any organs were injured or if there was anything else wrong. They did a cursory examination and took the x-rays, then sent him home with two medications: prednisolone and gavapetin for the pain. My cat couldn't move, so I trusted their instructions, and in four days, his right leg rotted away. He had bites under his fur that weren't visible. If they had examined him properly, if they had shaved him, they would have realized how bad his condition was. Now my cat is dead due to your negligence in not performing a proper examination. I told you he had been bitten by a dog because you didn't examine him properly. Nothing you say will bring him back, and it's not fair the kind of pain he had to endure. He would have needed stronger antibiotics and IV fluids. They haven't even made a follow-up call. I do not recommend this place. During the examination, they only... They kept asking if I was okay with the payment plan, how far I'd gone. All they care about is getting paid; they don't care about animals here. My cat died in five days because the vet who saw him didn't examine him properly after a dog bite. I only found this out when I took my cat back to the emergency vet, smelling awful and screaming in pain, but it was too late because of you.
I asked in the Cutler Bay group and they recommended this place, it was a really good choice. Dr. Machado is a sweetheart, his explanation was very good and I was happy with the price.

This is the best animal vet I have ever been to . Everyone is amazing! They love their job . They are affordable and knowledgeable . Dr Machado is the best . No words can describe how this doctor  has helped me with my dogs and cats ! Sois every other  vet I have seen at Aussie . All the team  is fabulous .Starting from the front office to all the assistants.

⭐️Highly recommended 👍👍👍👍👍👍👍

He described the problem in words I could understand. And he patiently answered All my questions. Which is a lot of questions.
I thoroughly recommend Dr Machado and his team.
Been going here for years, and continue to do so. We appreciate all the humble caring attention from the crew. Thank you!!!

amazing service from Jose and doctor Gaby!! easy and efficient customer service

Doctors and staff are very helpful and compassionate with the pets they treat.

Very good follow up care and always available to answer questions.

Decent price point for services provided. Not the most expensive, but not the cheapest. They do not try to sell you on unnecessary procedures for your pet. Very ethical and caring.

Absolutely horrible. This place used to be good years ago, but I recently came with my puppy and it was a terrible experience.

(1) They charged me $250 more than what they quoted me. When I brought up the original price they said “are you going to pay it or not”.  (2) The wait was over two hours on a week day with an appointment, and although I had an appointment with Dr Machado, he was “out sick”. I’m not sure if the person who ended up seeing us was a licensed doctor or a tech. (3) they were incredibly rude the whole time. My puppy is about 7 pounds and when I put her down to take out my wallet the guy at the front desk threw a temper tantrum and said “dogs aren’t allowed on the floor”. What kind of vet doesn’t allow dogs on the floor.

These were just some of issues. This place was good before but it seems like Dr. Machado is no longer there and is an absent owner with a hands off approach. I wish him the best but whoever is running it now is not running it the same. Stay away from this place.
Great staff. Dr. Machado is a great professional. Highly recommended.

If you’re looking for a vet in Miami, especially for cats, I highly recommend Aussie. You and your pet(s) will be in the best hands! Xo

Today I received her ashes, it was so meticulous wrapped and place and it even enclosed a paw print on my little girl left paw,that it showed me that they cared and were very concerned on how they treated her.
Thank you, Aussie A.H.,for considering my feelings and thank you for doing such a great job with her remains. I recommend anyone that looses a companion pet to have them handle the remains.You will have peace  knowing that they handle them with a lots of love.
